manifest.name: Coordinated XY MRES3 20 kHz Diagnostic v1

fixtures.operator_note: Confirm that the diagnostic MRES=3 image is flashed, both limit switches are released, the complete XY/Z envelope is clear, and the gantry is square. The selector homes Z then X/Y, runs ten moves at the same physical distances and nominal speed as the prior 40 kHz MRES=2 row using half the commanded steps at 20 kHz, and then performs bounded reference homes. Stop immediately for contact, abnormal sound, lost squareness, absent motion, or absent homing.
